slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: tier_name
slots.about: the name of the current league or tier

slots.name: items
slots.about: the people in the league: id, name, points, is_me (true on the person's own row)

slots.name: move_share
slots.about: the share of the league that moves up, 0 to 1; rounded to a count, at least one

slots.name: rule_word
slots.about: after the percent in the rule line, e.g. move up this week

slots.name: day_word
slots.about: after the count when one day is left

slots.name: days_word
slots.about: after the count when more days are left

slots.name: me_word
slots.about: beside the person's own name, so the own row is not told by colour alone

slots.name: inside_word
slots.about: the gap line of a row inside the move-up share

slots.name: to_cut_word
slots.about: after the points still needed to reach the move-up share

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when no one is ranked yet

attention.shows: the own row filled and tagged with me_word, its gap to the move-up share always shown; ranks inside the share in accent, the top three on a disc

labels.row: rank, name, points and me_word on the own row

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Equal points share a rank (1, 2, 2, 4) and stay in id order. The move-up count is the rounded share, at least one, so ties at the line all move up. Days left run to the end of the week from the phone's first_weekday.
